senses.gloss: different, a different thing.—[Targ. Prov. X, 14 שניא some ed., read: שֵׁצְיָא].—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:3:2">Y. Dem. I, 21ᵈ</cite> bot. [read] <he>לא ש׳ הוא דבר … הוא וכ׳</he> it makes no difference, (it is all the same) whether it is a plant the seed of which disappears (must be renewed every year) or &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:4:12">Y. Pes. V, 32ᶜ</cite> <he>לא ש׳ היא … היא וכ׳</he> it is all the same whether one slaughters a Passover sacrifice as a peace-offering or the reverse. Ib. X, end, 37ᵈ <he>ש׳ היא</he> it is a different case; a. fr.—[V. <cite ref="U00038"><he>שָׁאנֵי</he></cite>, s. v. <cite ref="U01586"><he>שְׁנֵי</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 30:10">Targ. Is. XXX, 10</cite> (h. text <he>מהתלות</he>).
